title: Result of update.offer: the job it opened
description: A pushed image answers next (0) and, only here, its transfer_token; a download answers next without a token; a LoRa transfer answers its token and the shape of the transfer (LORA_UPDATES.md section 4); an nRF52 serial DFU answers dfu (UPDATES.md).

next.description: 0 for a new job; a resumed LoRa transfer answers the frame it goes on from.

size.description: LoRa source only: the image as it will run.

transfer_size.description: LoRa source only: the bytes that travel (equal to size until a compressed transfer exists).

frame_bytes.description: LoRa source only: image bytes in every bulk frame but the last.
